color_system._description: Seven-swatch palette from near-black to parchment cream. Verified 2026-06-08 from approved Style Board provided by channel owner. All 7 values are human-approved and canonical. Initial image extraction produced 8 values (all NOT_VERIFIED) — approved Style Board collapses to 7 swatches (burnished_bronze removed as resolution artefact).

void_black.usage: base background for all primary surfaces, episode renders, title cards

deep_stone.usage: background variant, shadow fills, panel backgrounds, overlay bases

charcoal_earth.usage: card surfaces, hover states, secondary panel fills

ancient_soil.usage: border elements, separation lines, low-level accent fills

antique_gold.usage: icon fills, key text accents, decorative graphic elements, logo secondary color

warm_gold.usage: primary accent text on dark backgrounds, logo principal color, headline highlight, graphic element outlines

parchment_cream.usage: body text on dark backgrounds, subtitle text, light text elements, texture highlight

thumbnail_palette._note: Thumbnail color may depart from primary palette for CTR, but must remain within these bounds.
thumbnail_palette.allowed_range: Dark to warm-gold. High contrast between background and foreground. Stone and earth tones only for backgrounds.
thumbnail_palette.contrast_minimum: WCAG AA minimum. Gold text on near-black background.

color_system.text_on_dark: warm_gold (#E7D6B3) for display/titles. parchment_cream (#F5F3EE) for body.
color_system.text_on_light: TBD — no light surfaces appear in reference. Avoid until defined.
color_system.overlay_opacity_range: REQUIRES_HUMAN_APPROVAL — not in image; invented value with no visual basis

period_palette_constraints._note: Episode-specific period palettes must harmonise with the brand color system.

typography._description: Two-typeface system. Extracted directly from the typography specimen in bible.png. Font names are legible and certain.
typography._extraction_confidence: VERY HIGH — font names are clearly printed in the reference.

primary_typeface.use_case: All display text: channel name, episode titles, thumbnail headlines, section headers, graphic element labels
primary_typeface.case_rule: ALL CAPS only. Cinzel is a caps-only Roman typeface — lowercase forms are small caps.
primary_typeface._note: Google Font. Freely available. Modelled on classical Roman inscriptions.

secondary_typeface.use_case: All body text: subtitles, taglines, captions, Shorts overlays, metadata copy, supporting text in thumbnails and title cards
secondary_typeface.case_rule: Sentence case for body copy. ALL CAPS with wide tracking for navigation/label uses (as shown in footer categories).

thumbnail_language._description: Rules governing main episode thumbnail composition. Extracted from four thumbnail examples in bible.png.
thumbnail_language._extraction_confidence: HIGH — four distinct thumbnail variants are clearly visible.
required_elements: Channel wordmark (THE HYPOGEUM CHRONICLES) with full hierarchical treatment
Background: atmospheric stone, architectural, or environmental image
Episode-specific title or subtitle in Raleway beneath the wordmark (optional but present in 3 of 4 examples)
thumbnail_language.composition_model: Wordmark-dominant. The channel identity is the primary compositional anchor. Episode-specific imagery is background context, not foreground subject.
thumbnail_language.curiosity_gap_requirement: REQUIRES_HUMAN_APPROVAL — not in image; inferred editorial characterisation of thumbnail intent
thumbnail_language.wordmark_placement: Centred, upper-to-mid frame. THE / HYPOGEUM / CHRONICLES hierarchy preserved in all thumbnail variants.
thumbnail_language.background_treatment: Full-bleed atmospheric image. Dark treatment — void_black or deep_stone as dominant tone. Stone, ruins, underground architecture, maps, carvings. Slight vignette or darkening at edges to anchor the wordmark.
thumbnail_language.text_placement: Wordmark centred. Episode subtitle below wordmark, same horizontal axis.
thumbnail_language.text_hierarchy: THE (small) → HYPOGEUM (dominant) → — CHRONICLES — (medium) → episode title (Raleway, subordinate)

face_rules.conditions: No human faces in thumbnails. The brand uses environmental, architectural, and artefact imagery — not portraiture.
face_rules._note: None of the four thumbnail examples in the reference contain human faces.

thumbnail_variants.tagline_variant: Channel wordmark + tagline 'UNEARTHING THE STORY BENEATH OUR FEET'. Atmospheric background.
thumbnail_variants.episode_subtitle_variant: Channel wordmark + 'EPISODE N: [EPISODE TITLE]' in Raleway. Stone background.
thumbnail_variants.statement_variant: Channel wordmark + short declarative statement ('THE PAST IS NOT SILENT'). High-contrast stone background.
thumbnail_variants.wordmark_only_variant: Channel wordmark only. No subtitle. Strongest atmospheric background.

thumbnail_language.brightness_contrast_range: REQUIRES_HUMAN_APPROVAL — 0–40% brightness is an invented quantification with no stated basis in image. Observable fact: backgrounds are dark and high-contrast, but no numeric range is defined.

Emoji or symbols outside the defined graphic element vocabulary

documentary_visual_grammar._description: Permanent rules governing scene composition for this documentary-format channel. Confirmed by and consistent with the visual reference.
visual_reference_confirms: Underground chamber with dramatic light shaft — on-register
Ancient stone carvings and inscriptions — on-register
Mountainous landscape with dramatic atmosphere — on-register
Antique maps and cartographic materials — on-register
Single human silhouette against architectural scale — on-register
Arched stone corridors and ruins — on-register

forbidden_visual_modes._source: pre-existing VPD system prompt — NOT derived from bible.png. Confirmed absent in visual reference (consistent), but these rules predate this Bible.

documentary_visual_grammar.motion_rule: All figures derive motion from physical action, not from speech or facial expression.
documentary_visual_grammar.narration_model: Voice-over only. Visuals support narration; they do not depict it.
documentary_visual_grammar.person_speaking_substitution_rule: When a narration beat references a person speaking, substitute with: the artefact they referenced, the environment where they spoke, or their physical action. Document as CAPABILITY_LIMITED only if narrative intent is materially lost.

lighting_grammar._source: Inferred from visual style board imagery in bible.png. Directional light and high contrast are directly observable. Quantifications are invented.
lighting_grammar.primary_source: Single strong directional source — shaft of light, torch, candle, opening in ceiling or wall
lighting_grammar._primary_source_confidence: HIGH — directly observable in multiple style board images
lighting_grammar.character: Warm amber or cool natural daylight. Never flat studio lighting.
lighting_grammar.shadow_depth: REQUIRES_HUMAN_APPROVAL — 'approximately 70-90%' is an invented quantification. Observable fact: deep shadow is present throughout. No numeric value is stated in the reference.
lighting_grammar.highlight_ratio: High contrast. Light source is the story element. Darkness is the context.
lighting_grammar._highlight_ratio_confidence: MEDIUM — inferred from observation, not stated

motion_language.motion_speed_register: Slow. Deliberate. All camera movement is measured and purposeful. Nothing is frantic.

preferred_motion_by_scene_type.establishing: slow_push_in or slow_pan — reveal the space gradually
preferred_motion_by_scene_type.detail_shot: static or very slow_push_in — hold on the artefact or surface
preferred_motion_by_scene_type.revelation: slow_push_in toward key subject — the camera acknowledges significance
preferred_motion_by_scene_type.transition: static cut or slow_pull_out — exit as slowly as entry
preferred_motion_by_scene_type.atmospheric: environmental_motion_only — let the world move, not the camera
preferred_motion_by_scene_type.underground_chamber: slow_pan revealing architecture — single light source as focal anchor

camera_movement_vocabulary: slow tilt up to reveal scale
forbidden_motion_patterns: Character-driven camera (POV unless explicitly archaeological — first-person discovery moment)
